findings.text: Spec criterion 4 requires both SKILL.md files to describe the change and the tables of renamed codes and MCP tags. Neither does. claude-code SKILL.md has only the <michal:human> example fix (no legacyCode, code table, tag table or limity->limits / uwaga->note). claude-skill SKILL.md (line 392) has one legacyCode sentence, but no code table, no tag table, no renamed fields. Repro: grep -c 'wrong_password\|QUESTION' on both files gives 0. Only NEWS.md carries the tables. Add th [full: .full.txt]

Gate coverage gaps. Probes fire for filenames, titles, strings, identifiers, comments (ts/js/css/html/sh/Dockerfile) and markdown (mutated scratch copy: each fails the gate). Not scanned: .json (zz.json with Polish text passes), .svg, .py, .txt and extensionless hooks, and string literals in integrations/**.mjs and src/http/ui/js (strings check is limited to src/ and bin/). Current tree has no Polish diacritics outside i18n-pl.js.

The UI error dictionary lacks about 36 English codes (e.g. too_many_attempts, token_revoked, invalid_json). The base dictionary lacked the same codes, so this is not a regression (checked: every old key maps to a head key; 54 -> 55), and the UI falls back to the server text, not a raw code. Informational.
